base_member_text: [L1349-L1436] (MED/unbounded-iteration) All turbulent conductivity fixed-point loops have no iteration cap or non-finite escape even though maxiter is declared elsewhere in the module, so a nonconvergent cell can stall the timestep.
audit_member_text: [L1349-L1436,L1575-L1613] (MED/unbounded nonlinear iteration) Turbulent conductivity iterations have no iteration limit or non-finite/stagnation exit.

base_member_text: [L1471-L1532, L220-L258, L520-L523] (MED/pointer-alias/leak) infilcon is first allocated as independent storage and later pointer-associated with s%infil through the hydrostatic function, orphaning the original allocation and making later mode behavior depend on aliasing.
audit_member_text: [L523,L210-L242] (LOW/pointer target leak) infilcon is first allocated its own target and later pointer-reassociated to s%infil, permanently losing the original allocation.

base_member_text: [L896-L900, L914-L916, L1001-L1005, L1017-L1019, L1103-L1105] (HIGH/zero-thickness-singularity) Exponential-head formulas divide by groundwater thickness at cells where gwheight can legitimately be zero at the aquifer bottom, with no limiting form or dry-cell guard.
audit_member_text: [L836-L905,L913-L917,L1001-L1005,L1016-L1019,L1103-L1105] (HIGH/zero aquifer-height singularity) The exponential head formulation repeatedly evaluates sinh(h)/h at cells whose groundwater height can be zero, without a limiting-form implementation or mask.

base_member_text: [L1568-L1643] (MED/division-by-zero) Local infiltration divides by dt/por and later by dis and infil without guarding zero conductivity, zero timestep, zero porosity, or a zero computed infiltration distance.
audit_member_text: [L1567-L1642] (MED/zero timestep/porosity/progress denominator) Local infiltration divides by dt, porosity, twodtp, dis, and infiltration rate without explicit guards, so zero conductivity or invalid timestep/porosity can cause singular intermediate arithmetic.

base_member_text: [L724-L739, L1478-L1513] (MED/zero-transition-width) dwetlayer is used as a divisor in both the smoothing ratio and hydrostatic infiltration cap without a local positive-width check.
audit_member_text: [L734-L738] (MED/zero smoothing thickness) The wet-layer ratio divides by dwetlayer with no positive-value guard.

base_member_text: [L976-L1009] (HIGH/wrong-loop-index) The fast 2-D exponential solver loops on k but never sets i, then uses the initialized value i=0 in grid and coefficient subscripts, causing invalid indexing.
audit_member_text: [L976-L1009] (HIGH/wrong loop variable/index) The fast 2-D exponential solver loops on k but never sets i, so it uses stale/zero i to index all grid fields and metrics.

base_member_text: [L1025-L1106] (HIGH/unimplemented-selection) The full 2-D solver builds and solves coefficients only for the parabolic model, but afterward accepts the exponential model and computes a head from gwcurv that this branch never solved.
audit_member_text: [L1025-L1106] (HIGH/missing solver implementation) The full 2-D branch builds and solves a matrix only for the parabolic model; selecting exponential skips the solve and then computes gwhead from stale gwcurv.

audit_member_text: [L400-L411] (LOW/anisotropic smoothing) Updated Kx, Ky, and Kz are all smoothed only along the i direction, even for the nominal y-direction conductivity Ky.
